//: Type errors the verification scripts are allowed to carry, per file. This is a ratchet: a file may not grow, no new file may appear, and fixing errors means lowering the number here. Run `npm run types:budget` after a fix.
why: src/ is typechecked by `tsc -p tsconfig.json`; scripts/ was never included, so 43 verification suites grew 108 type errors unnoticed. This file makes the remainder visible and stops it growing. Each entry is a known, harmless-at-runtime mismatch in test code (object literals missing optional fields, a test reaching a private field of its own fake). They should be burned down, not added to.
